Changelog

What's new in Strike-Command: Idle Scrims, newest first.

Unreleased — will be v1.1.09 (97)

  • No more ghost players: empty lineup slots no longer spawn filler Recruits — a 3-agent lineup plays a real 3v5. Assign nobody and the match simply won't start (you'll get a nudge to set your lineup first)

Unreleased — will be v1.1.08 (96)

  • Round-winning moments breathe: the deciding elimination kill and a completed defuse now play out for a beat before the score moves (the winner is already locked — you just get to see it land), matching the bomb-blast delay

Unreleased — will be v1.1.07 (95)

  • Utility costs money now, like real CS: smokes, flashes, HEs and molotovs are bought from each agent's own wallet on force/full rounds — pistol rounds and eco/save calls play without grenades, and broke squads simply field less utility
  • The scoreboard shows each agent's held grenades as small pips next to their weapon (your squad only)
  • Clearer loadout icons: a proper kevlar vest and wire cutters replace the hard-to-read armor/kit glyphs, and each grenade type gets its own icon

Unreleased — will be v1.1.06 (94)

  • The live scoreboard now shows each agent's loadout beside their name, CS-style: the weapon they're carrying this round plus armor and defuse-kit pips when they bought them — for both squads

Unreleased — will be v1.1.05 (93)

  • Fixed agents standing oblivious when a smoke fades: eyesight no longer stops at weapon range — agents now spot and track visible enemies beyond it (they still only fire once in range), so a fading smoke starts the watch immediately
  • The planted bomb now uses the proper satchel model with a blinking red LED; the dropped bomb keeps its amber beacon with no red blink

Unreleased — will be v1.1.04 (92)

  • Defenses got smarter: some rounds a defender now plays mid hunting for picks — and when it spots the push coming it calls an early rotation, so teammates peel off to the threatened site much faster
  • Fire discipline: agents now tap-fire at long range (more accurate), burst at mid range as before, and spray when several enemies are close in front
  • Agents turn to face where they're throwing before a grenade leaves their hand — no more blind over-the-shoulder smokes

Unreleased — will be v1.0.98 (86)

  • Fixed total audio silence: the background-mute could suspend the sound engine during startup and never wake it (splash-screen timing) — audio now mutes only when the app is truly in the background

Unreleased — will be v1.1.03 (91)

  • Classic CS pacing: rounds are now 1:45 and the bomb fuse is 45 seconds — more time for slow plays, retakes and clutch attempts
  • New purchasable gear: armor ($650) blunts incoming bullet and blast damage, and defenders can buy a defuse kit ($400) that halves the defuse to 1.5 seconds — bought after your weapon on force/full rounds when your wallet covers it, and smart agents attempt kit defuses they'd otherwise bail from

Unreleased — will be v1.1.02 (90)

  • Loading splash at startup: a tactical Strike-Command title screen appears after the intro video as the game finishes loading, then fades you into the action

Unreleased — will be v1.1.01 (89)

  • Combat audio no longer sounds culled: the sim batches a second of gunfire per tick and the old scheduler dropped everything past 0.35s — the full batch now plays at each weapon's real cadence
  • Intro splash fills the whole screen and respects the OFF toggle correctly
  • Back button asks before quitting: press back again within 2 seconds to exit
  • Toasts cap at 3 on screen (spam-refreshing the market can't bury the display)

Unreleased — will be v1.1.00 (88)

  • Milestone build: everything since v1.0.98 — bomb blast damage with save-your-gear behavior and coordinated retakes, realistic combat audio with per-bullet firefights and background mute, the studio intro splash (skippable, toggleable), per-rarity GUARD chips on the transfer market, per-agent wallet cap at $16,000, and the live service status page at chaoticgamestudios.com/status.html

Unreleased — will be v1.0.99 (87)

  • The bomb blast hurts now: point-blank is lethal, with heavy falloff out to the edge of the blast — for BOTH teams. The explosion plays out for a moment (with its casualties) before the round is called
  • Agents save themselves: when the fuse can't be beaten, defenders abandon the site and everyone clears the blast radius — a defuse that will still finish in time is held to the win
  • Retakes actually happen: after a plant, defenders converge on the site for a coordinated take-back instead of camping off-site forever while attackers sit on the bomb

Unreleased — will be v1.0.97 (85)

  • Automatic fire now sounds like real combat: every bullet your agents fire adds to the mix at each weapon's true cyclic rate — SMGs chatter, rifles crackle, snipers boom — instead of an occasional pop
  • New event sounds: flashbang bang, smoke pop-and-hiss, and proper victory/defeat stingers when a match ends (still all CC0)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.96 (84)

  • Combat audio rework: real firearm recordings replace the sci-fi laser sounds — rifle crack, SMG pop, heavy sniper boom, shotgun blast, LMG rattle, pistol pop — plus a punchier bomb explosion (all CC0, still no Counter-Strike audio)
  • Firefights now actually sound like firefights: a live battle-ambience layer plays while agents trade shots, not just when someone dies
  • Round win/lose sounds replaced with short, subtle tick/thud stingers (the jingles are gone)
  • Fixed a stray "false" text rendering above the BACK UP NOW button in the Manager

Unreleased — will be v1.0.95 (83)

  • Game audio is here: gunfire per weapon class, bomb plant/defuse/explosion, and round win/lose stingers during live matches, plus an ambient music loop on the menu screens (all original CC0 sounds — no Counter-Strike audio)
  • New SOUND section in the Manager: separate SOUND FX and MUSIC volume sliders (drag to 0 to mute)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.94 (82)

  • No more account picker on every app start: your sign-in restores silently when possible and otherwise waits — the Manager shows a RECONNECT button when a fresh session is needed
  • Error messages that fired while a dialog was open were hidden behind it — they show on top now (this is why the team-name rename seemed to do nothing)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.93 (81)

  • Google sign-in is back to a single account picker (identity + cloud backup permission in one step) now that the Play signing-certificate issue that caused "reauth failed [16]" is fully fixed

Unreleased — will be v1.0.92 (80)

  • Agents now sense enemies at point-blank range even when they're standing perfectly quiet — no more oblivious defenders with an enemy on the other side of the wall (it sharpens their aim and turning, it doesn't let them shoot through walls)
  • New Awareness upgrade line: trains the whole squad's hearing — footsteps, proximity sense and gunfire all reach further

Unreleased — will be v1.0.91 (79)

  • The two clutch lines are now one: the 🔥 Clutch line trains both the team's 1vX bonus and your agents' Clutch stat — levels from the retired Clutch Play line carry over automatically
  • Reaction speed is now trained only by Reflex Drills — the Aim line is accuracy only

Unreleased — will be v1.0.90 (78)

  • Scout screen: fixed the probability labels overlapping each other and the chart edges now that there are eight rarities — names and percentages are stacked cleanly around the radar
  • Agent portraits: the 30 mirrored variants were upside down — they're now proper left-right mirrors
  • The four stat training lines (Reflex Drills, Utility School, Entry Drills, Clutch Play) get their own icons instead of sharing Aim/Tactics/Movement/Clutch's
  • Team formation: IGL and AVP nudged up, ENT nudged down so the taller stat cards don't clip each other

Unreleased — will be v1.0.89 (77)

  • Fixed a crash on sign-in: the rankings attestation plugin (Play Integrity) was killing the whole app right after you picked your Google account — this was behind the "select account, then nothing" failures and the consent screen vanishing mid sign-in
  • Sign-in picker restored to the full account list

Unreleased — will be v1.0.88 (76)

  • Google sign-in reworked into two stages: basic sign-in first (always works), then the Drive-backup permission as a separate step — if the second step is refused you stay signed in for rankings and cloud backup simply waits, instead of the whole sign-in failing with "reauth failed [16]"
  • The sign-in picker now shows ALL Google accounts on the device (previously only previously-authorized ones, which locked players out after revoking access)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.87 (75)

  • Money is now per-agent, CS-style: every player has their own wallet — round income (win/loss, plant and defuse bonuses) lands in all five wallets, kill rewards go to the killer alone, and every buy comes out of the agent's own pocket, so a rich carry can full-buy while a broke teammate falls back to a cheaper gun
  • The live scoreboard gains a $ column showing each of your agents' current wallet (enemy wallets stay hidden); the decision bar now shows your squad's total cash
  • Old saves carry over: a team cash pool is split evenly across the five wallets

Unreleased — will be v1.0.86 (74)

  • The full Counter-Strike arsenal joins the buy economy: 16 new weapons — FAMAS, Galil AR, AUG, SG 553, SSG 08, G3SG1, SCAR-20, P90, UMP-45, MAG-7, Sawed-Off, XM1014, Desert Eagle, Five-SeveN, Tec-9 and P250 — each with its own price and its own silhouette in the kill feed
  • Smarter buys: force rounds now fall back through class-appropriate rungs (a rifler reaches for a FAMAS or Galil, a sniper for an SSG 08, shotguns for a MAG-7 or Sawed-Off), a rich SAVE round treats the early slots to hero pistols without dipping below full-buy money, and the full-buy luxury upgrade now rotates through a pool of heavy weapons round to round
  • Play-by-play: a new collapsible text feed under the scoreboard narrates the match as it happens — kills (with weapons and headshots), plants, defuses, clutch situations, each team's buy and pace calls, and round-by-round results with the running score

Unreleased — will be v1.0.85 (73)

  • Two new weapons join the buy economy: the Negev ($1,700) — a cheap spray LMG teams fall back to on force rounds when a primary is out of reach — and the M249 ($5,200) — a heavy a rich team picks up for one rifle player on a full buy with cash to spare (it trades the signature bonus for raw stopping power)
  • Opposing squads now field a Negev in their lineup rotation

Unreleased — will be v1.0.84 (72)

  • Buy economy: each team now earns match money every round (win/loss income, plant and defuse bonuses, kill rewards, escalating loss-streak bonus) and buys its weapons at the start of every round — pistols are free on round 1 and after the halftime swap
  • Manager calls: a new decision bar under the match view shows your team's cash and lets you call the next round's buy (SAVE / ECO / FORCE / FULL) and pace (FAST / DEFAULT / SLOW); the auto-call pre-selects a sensible choice, your tap overrides it for one round, and an AUTO toggle makes matches fully hands-off
  • Signature weapons: an agent playing its signature weapon gets +10% accuracy and +10% reaction speed

Unreleased — will be v1.0.83 (71)

  • Agents gain four new stats — Reflex (faster reactions), Utility (earlier, better-placed grenades), Entry (first-contact bonus on a push) and Clutch (fights harder when outnumbered) — rolled per agent within their rarity band, so two agents with the same rating can play very differently; shown on every agent card
  • Four new team upgrade lines (Reflex Drills, Utility School, Entry Drills, Clutch Play) train those stats for the whole squad

Unreleased — will be v1.0.82 (70)

  • Live match scoreboard under the match view: per-agent K/D/A for both squads with a live MVP each match (assists count for teammates who helped land a kill) — collapsible, updates every round

Unreleased — will be v1.0.81 (69)

  • Portrait pool doubled to 60 faces (mirror variants) — far fewer repeat faces across agents

Unreleased — will be v1.0.80 (68)

  • Team formation: repositioned slots so cards no longer clip each other or the map edges (IGL/AVP up, ENT down)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.79 (67)

  • Agents strafe in fights — they sidestep while keeping their aim on the threat instead of standing flat-footed — and take corners smoothly on the move (no more robot pivots)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.78 (66)

  • Internal: apps now attest device/app integrity (Play Integrity on Android, App Attest on iOS) and send the verdict with ranked writes — foundation for ranked anti-cheat; invisible to players

Unreleased — will be v1.0.77 (65)

  • Smarter defuse decisions: defenders now weigh the odds and fight instead of dying on the bomb when attackers are watching it
  • Attackers spray through smoke at the bomb area when a defuse starts behind it — keep your head down on the retake
  • Friendly fire is on: explosions, molotovs and stray bullets hit your own squad too — watch your grenades

Unreleased — will be v1.0.76 (64)

  • Agents now have unique tactical portraits: every agent card shows a photoreal operator photo (stable per agent name) instead of the generic silhouette — signature agent Phoenixx has her own signature look

Unreleased — will be v1.0.75 (63)

  • All three maps rebuilt from the ground up: Crossfire, Dustfall, and Sandspire get all-new layouts and art

Unreleased — will be v1.0.74 (62)

  • Fixed agents idling against walls: molotov-escape goals are no longer accepted when they land inside a wall the nav graph can't reach, and the post-plant bomb guard no longer anchors inside the wall next to wall-adjacent sites (falls back to the nearest reachable hold)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.73 (61)

  • New map Bastion (debug-sideload only for now): third image-backed conversion — castle ruins, A site top-center / B site left-center in a ruins courtyard, defenders in the blue zone top-left, attackers in the red zone bottom-right across a curved cobble bridge; force it with localStorage 'sc_debug_map' = 'bastion'; not in the normal map rotation yet

Unreleased — will be v1.0.72 (60)

  • Foundry: second image-backed map (debug sideload only for now) — facility layout with 13 hand-verified doorway carves, per-site route vias
  • Fixed phantom dropped-bomb marker lingering after a successful plant (carrier flag wasn't cleared)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.71 (59)

  • Attack plans now pick from per-site corridor options, so pushes split across real routes (Apex bottom-west is finally in play); per-agent path jitter adds within-corridor variety
  • New map Foundry (debug-sideload only for now): second image-backed conversion — lighter facility blueprint, A bottom-left / B top-right, defenders in the blue zone top-left, attackers in the red zone bottom-right; force it with localStorage 'sc_debug_map' = 'foundry'; not in the normal map rotation yet
  • Foundry playtest fixes: defenders now actually use the west channel from CT spawn down to A (was sealed by a drawn 18px corridor the grid squeezed shut), the B -> A mid route through the central rooms is connected, and defenders roll seeded corridor alternates (deploy / rotation / retake vias, capped at 1.35x the direct route) so approaches split across real corridors

Unreleased — will be v1.0.70 (58)

  • Route variety: agents vary their paths per round (seeded per-agent cost jitter) — attacks and rotations stop conga-lining down one corridor; near-equal corridors (like Apex's mid bend vs bottom-west) both get used

Unreleased — will be v1.0.69 (57)

  • Cloud saves now compare PROGRESS, not just timestamps: at boot, if the cloud backup is clearly further along than this device, the game asks "Cloud save found — restore it and overwrite this device?" before anything is overwritten (RESTORE pulls the cloud save, KEEP MINE keeps this device; both Google Drive and Apple). Fixes a real reinstall data loss where playing one match before signing in let the weak local save overwrite the good cloud backup

Unreleased — will be v1.0.68 (56)

  • Transfer market: refreshing with a LEGENDARY-or-better listing on screen asks for confirmation first (no more fat-fingered rares)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.67 (55)

  • New map Apex (debug-sideload only for now): image-backed conversion of a tactical floor-plan blueprint — force it with localStorage 'sc_debug_map' = 'apex'; not in the normal map rotation yet

Unreleased — will be v1.0.66 (54)

  • Renamed the Glock pistol to P9 (trademark hygiene)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.65 (53)

  • In-game support tickets: Manager → SUPPORT lets you file a ticket (purchase / bug / account / other) and read the replies under MY TICKETS — needs cloud sign-in so we know which account to help; 5 tickets per day
  • Admin panel on the rankings server (operator-only): player lookup, anti-cheat flag review, and a support inbox with replies — no database access needed

Unreleased — will be v1.0.64 (52)

  • Restore purchases now waits for server validation before reporting (previously always said "nothing to restore"); new changelog page on the website

Unreleased — will be v1.0.63 (51)

  • Device-test fixes: restore purchases now finds owned non-consumables (platform-scoped lookup), notification toggle no longer needs off-on to prompt, scout radar labels spaced for 8 tiers, Relic is now deep red

Unreleased — will be v1.0.62 (50)

  • Two new rarity tiers above Godlike: ANCIENT (prismatic teal) and RELIC (cosmic magenta) — higher stat bands, tiny scout odds from L7/L9, market prices anchored at ~120h/~300h of income; signature agents now come in all 8 tiers
  • Animated rarity frames: Godlike pulses a gold glow, Ancient gets a shimmer sweep, Relic a shifting multi-color aura (CSS-only, respects reduced-motion)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.61 (49)

  • Daily reminder notification (18:30 local): one on-device local notification a day brings you back to collect income and run the tactics board — works fully offline, no server. On by default with an off switch in Manager → NOTIFICATIONS; the app only ever asks for notification permission when you tap the toggle, never at launch

Unreleased — will be v1.0.60 (48)

  • Top-bar crystal icon now matches the 💎 used everywhere else (was a different SVG gem)

Unreleased — will be v1.0.59 (47)

  • Internal: sign-in failure toasts now include the underlying error detail (diagnosing Android reauth issue)

v1.0.58 (46) — uploaded to closed testing 2026-07-28

  • Faster income progression and more trophies per season (including 1 for any finished season); career skills stronger per level
  • Power upgrades now apply from the next round of a live match
  • Fixed pack odds: Epic and Legendary can actually drop at any scout level (were impossible at low scout since v1.0.22)
  • Bulk sell on the Team screen: pick rarities, sell bench players in one tap
  • Purchases verified server-side on both stores; fixed duplicate crystal grants; store-unavailable products no longer fall back to a granting mock
  • Cloud save: a fresh reinstall now restores your real backup instead of overwriting it (both Google Drive and Apple); sign-in no longer prompts at every app start
  • Crystal packs rebalanced with better mid-tier value + two new packs ($19.99, $49.99)
  • Page zoom disabled on mobile
  • iOS-only (no Android behavior change): Sign in with Apple cloud saves, iOS LIVE rankings, App Store billing, ATT prompt, iOS icon

v1.0.43 (31) — uploaded to closed testing 2026-07-25

  • Full game reset in Manager → DANGER ZONE (two confirmations; deletes the cloud backup first so it can't restore over a fresh start)
  • iOS platform scaffolding: Capacitor iOS project, ATT prompt, per-platform ad units, Xcode Cloud build script, App Store setup checklist (no player-facing changes on Android; ships in this build — VC30 was never uploaded)

v1.0.41 (29) — uploaded to closed testing 2026-07-23

  • Career mode is visible: your agent's frags appear in the kill feed with a ⭐ and a toast; career screen shows rating, power contribution, per-level skill effects, and grenade milestones; agent name is editable
  • Coin flip at match start: you now randomly attack or defend first half (halftime swap unchanged)
  • Soldiers can HEAR: nearby enemies are sensed through walls, gunfire is audible at range — defenders react instead of standing idle
  • Smoke grenades extinguish molotov fire, and teams use this deliberately; smoke + molotov no longer thrown together
  • Cups are contested: win chances scale with your power vs the cup's tier; cooldowns between entries (4h/12h/24h); rewards scale with your income
  • Relegation: bottom 3 each season drop a league (Silver is the floor) — auto-promote opt-out doesn't protect you
  • Transfer market shows a green ▲ on agents stronger than your current player in that position
  • Statistics tab gains "Rounds (career)"
  • Long nameplates (e.g. StrclyChaos) shrink/truncate instead of clipping; plates shift inward at map edges
  • World Ranking never shows "—" for your rank (falls back to local sim, re-syncs in background)
  • Simulated teams now have gamertag-style names (hosted world migrated too)
  • Android targetSdk 36 (Play API requirement)

v1.0.39 (27)

  • Top bar: abbreviated money ($128K/$9.9M/$1.2B) always fully visible with icons at any screen width

v1.0.38 (26)

  • Fix: cash pill could overlap the centered income on narrow phones

v1.0.37 (25)

  • Fix: match header cut off defender power with long team names

v1.0.36 (24)

  • New teams start with a generated name (Agent + 6 digits) instead of everyone sharing one default

v1.0.35 (23)

  • Unique team names (3–12 chars), enforced worldwide; rename once per 7 days, old name freed
  • Team identity bound to Google sign-in — copied backups can't steal your name
  • Profanity filter on team names (evasion-safe, false-positive protected)
  • Renaming requires an internet connection

v1.0.34 (22)

  • Income + power now truly centered in the top bar

v1.0.33 (21)

  • StrclyChaos & Phoenixx can now be pulled from packs and the free daily video pack (2% per card)

v1.0.32 (20)

  • New signature agents: StrclyChaos (rifle) and Phoenixx (shotgun) — the best of every rarity tier

v1.0.31 (19)

  • Attackers always red / defenders always blue, side tags (ATK/DEF) in the match header, colors swap at halftime
  • Attackers now guard the planted bomb and swarm defusers; hits reset the defuse channel
  • Guns point exactly where soldiers aim; per-soldier gear variation (visors, pads, backpacks)
  • League rivals grow through the season and partially track your growth — no more steamrolling
  • Season Pass: 30-day season with live countdown; max rewards reachable in ~27 days
  • World Ranking syncs hourly

v1.0.30 (18)

  • Hosted World Ranking: one shared 120,000-team ladder with real players, anti-cheat validation, offline fallback
  • Public live leaderboard at strikecommand.chaoticgamestudios.com/rankings.html

v1.0.29 (17)

  • Halftime side swap after round 12 + new pistol round (you get your turn attacking)
  • Defenders cover the closest bombsite; the bomb is a physical item — carried, dropped on death, recovered by teammates
  • Sign-in no longer shows the account picker on every app start

v1.0.28 (16)

  • Much smoother soldier movement (per-substep trails, eased turning)

v1.0.27 (16)

  • Automatic cloud backups after one sign-in (silent re-auth on app start, backup on exit)

v1.0.26 (15) — first closed-testing build

  • Google Sign-In + cloud save to your own Google Drive
  • Live AdMob ads, real store products
  • Renamed to Strike-Command: Idle Scrims
